pair_reasons: Every one of the four hits essentially all 20 key items: the sentinel gate at :1205, the mechanical arm that never prints its own block (M2), one payload per Stop, CC_MECH_MAX :-3 vs :-2, the per-arm disable vars, the wake-floor abstains, and 🚀 needing only session_writes_paths. W, Y and Z correctly flag the :963-966 comment as false, and X's per-arm statements agree with the code, so nobody is penalised on that point. W beats Y on k14 plus more verified extras (stdin fields and no stop_hook_active, Land IN FLIGHT, set converting a mechanical chain), and Y's 'CLAUDE_CONTINUE_MAX=0 means the hook never blocks' is overbroad. W vs Z and Y vs Z are ties: in each pair the defects are of comparable weight (W's misplaced stale-comment lines vs Z's code-contradicted gate claim; Y's k14 gap vs Z's wrong 🔧-cause claim), and neither side shows a decisive material advantage.
